authorization: 사용자: 다른 장비에서 git pull 후 야간에 두 설계를 실행; data와 checkpoint는 해당 장비에 이미 존재
scope: Portable preparation and execution of both previously proposed classifiers. No automatic claim of superiority or manuscript adoption.
runtime_dependencies: Source suite, tracked code and input reference only; historical EXP89/90 results are not required for preparation.
sampling: Rebuild original EXP89 scenario chronological split. Reproduce EXP89 class-specific 20-row draws and nested attack prefixes; reproduce EXP90 fixed750 benign draws. No conflict-label curation. Select U uniformly from train without reading family labels; exclude all n<=20 labeled feature groups within seed, so U stays fixed across n.
evaluation: Full original test in seed43 permutation, not a subset. Preserve and audit historical train/U-test exact-feature overlap; these are exploratory results on a previously inspected split, not independent confirmation.
features: Existing 46 float32 row-local features and zero filling; PROTOCOL and L7_PROTO at columns 0,1 explicitly categorical for both models. Benign ID read from manifest (CIC2018=0, ToN-IoT=1).
artifacts: NPZs and checkpoints stay outside Git; code recreates inputs on each machine. Store hashes, real IDs, budgets, predictions, models, logs and per-condition metrics in the registered run.
